title: What came between Lan Xang and Kingdom of Laos?
question: What came between Lan Xang and Kingdom of Laos?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Lan Xang (1354) to Kingdom of Laos (1947): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.

records.description: unified kingdom from 1354 to 1707, one of the largest kingdoms in Southeast Asia
